fullPassage: Triboulet was born in France in the 15th century. His body looked different from those of other people. He had short, crooked legs and long arms. People teased him about how he looked, but Triboulet just made it part of his sense of humor. He was so funny that it was his job to make the king laugh. But Triboulet was not just funny. He was also very bold. One day, Triboulet found himself in serious trouble. He had decided to slap the backside of the king. The king didn't consider it funny and demanded an apology. Triboulet apologized by saying, "I'm sorry. I didn't recognize you! I thought you were the queen!" The king found this even less amusing. He decided to put him to death. He allowed Triboulet to choose how he would die. Triboulet immediately replied, "I choose to die of old age." The king liked this clever answer, so he called off the execution.
